authority.canonical_push_policy: DENY via local config and disabled push URL

product_build.name: AER Minimum Learning MVP
product_build.runtime: CPython 3.12.13 bundled with Codex workspace dependencies
product_build.content_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of a UTF-8 LF manifest containing '<file_sha256><two spaces><relative_path><LF>' in ordinal filename order; RUN_CONFIGURATION.json excluded

common.execution_environment: Codex Desktop local task on Windows; one fresh task directory per Task x Condition; service tier default
common.ocr_parser: UTF-8 Markdown and JSON direct read; no OCR because the frozen Public/Pulse packages contain only .md and .json payloads
common.parser_runtime: CPython 3.12.13 standard library for ZIP/JSON verification and direct UTF-8 text; PowerShell 7.6.4 for byte/hash checks
common.search_engine: ripgrep 15.2.0 exact/regex search plus direct full-corpus file reads over only the released phase corpus
common.reranker: none; the entire released corpus is directly readable and no candidate truncation/reranking stage is used

context_limit.enforcement: pre-registered append-only logging and operator stop at the first configured limit; the Evaluation/Execution Contracts do not require a model-level hard cap

cost_limit.codex_account: same signed-in account and same service tier for B0 and Product
cost_limit.enforcement: one Codex task, no external API key or paid external tool, append-only execution logging, and operator stop at the first configured call/time/cost limit

time_limit.clock_start: first fixture/corpus-specific human contact, including ingestion or indexing preparation
time_limit.clock_stop: final answer and next action submitted or an earlier termination condition fires

B0.initial_state: fresh task and empty condition-local notes; no prior task or condition state

tools: control-state export, review, relate, pulse, validate, and cost-log commands
Product.initial_state: fresh task and empty SQLite database created before fixture-specific ingest; no pre-generated fixture-specific labels or relations

source_and_truth_access.initial_release: only AER_EVAL_PUBLIC_RUN_PACKAGE_V0_3.zip; Pulse package name, paths, manifest, and existence are not disclosed
source_and_truth_access.pulse_release: only the applicable Task payload after both B0 and Product initial outputs for that Task are frozen
source_and_truth_access.common_corpus: both conditions receive byte-identical released packages and the same POLICY_MANIFEST.json
source_and_truth_access.original_viewing: allowed for both conditions only for currently released source files within policy scope
source_and_truth_access.sealed_truth: forbidden to R4 blind operators and inaccessible from the intended run mount
source_and_truth_access.current_host_enforcement: PASS by distribution boundary: R4 receives and extracts exactly one immutable Task x Condition package into an empty Observation workspace on which the separate Evaluation workspace is not present, mounted, copied, or discoverable. A broad-read workspace containing Evaluation assets is not an eligible R4 environment.

observation_distribution.observation_workspace: one empty package-only workspace per Task x Condition; only released public input, condition assets, common runtime declarations, and append-only logs
observation_distribution.evaluation_workspace: separate workspace retaining sealed truth, evaluator-only materials, contracts, and frozen outputs; never transferred or mounted into an Observation workspace

human_intervention.authoritative_log: condition-external append-only JSONL plus Task Observation Record v0.2; Product operation-table cost records are secondary reconciliation evidence only
allowed_for_both: ask up to the common call limit
correct the final reconstruction before submission
record all human time and interventions
product_only_allowed: ingest released inputs into an initially empty control state
review or correct one control-state field
export and validate the control state
forbidden: unlogged review, correction, or Pulse work
human_intervention.generic_orientation: fixture-blind common environment orientation is recorded separately; any fixture-specific judgment starts the Task clock
human_intervention.external_new_pm: same frozen reconstruction result format and the same External New-PM Prompt v0.2; condition label hidden; no Product-only explanation or onboarding

isolation.initial: fresh Codex task and fresh directory for every Task x Condition; no prior task, condition, output, note, search result, or state is mounted
isolation.pulse_continuity: only the same Task x Condition initial notes and, for Product, its own SQLite state continue to pulse
isolation.external_new_pm: fresh isolated task for every Task x Condition x Phase; first response frozen; no retry for improvement
isolation.result_queue: operator writes output to a condition-opaque queue; sibling condition results are not mounted into operator tasks

execution_termination.rule: Stop at the first applicable condition.
conditions: Task final answer and next action submitted
60 wall-clock minutes reached for the current Task x Condition x Phase
6 user submissions reached for the current phase
120000 input-token or 12000 output-token operator budget reached when observable
apparatus_incident_conditions: sealed truth path or content exposure
model, parser, search, reranker, permission, corpus, or limit mismatch
condition-local state cannot be resumed for its own Pulse
execution_termination.incident_disposition: freeze output; mark apparatus incident; do not score as product performance; do not continue as the same run

differences.Product: minimum_learning_mvp.py commands limited to creating, querying, reviewing, correcting, validating, and pulsing the persistent state
differences.basis: minimum tool needed to operate the frozen independent variable
durability is the frozen independent variable; Product database is never visible to B0

freeze.configuration_sha256_scope: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 RUN_CONFIGURATION.json bytes with freeze.configuration_sha256 set to the literal SELF_EXCLUDED

superseded_freeze.incident: The five frozen Product file hashes remained unchanged and matched 5/5, but the aggregate identity was not reproducible under the declared algorithm. The prior freeze was invalidated without changing Product content or execution conditions.

freeze.post_freeze_change_boundary: After a future PASS freeze, no model/effort, parser, search, reranker, corpus, package, permission, prompt, limit, product content, cost boundary, isolation rule, termination rule, or human-intervention rule may change except for an execution-blocking technical defect, material Evaluation Contract contradiction, or security/permission impossibility.
